Thank you for that initial information. To better understand your symptoms, could you describe exactly how the swelling in your right knee started and if you've experienced any pain or difficulty moving it?

Also, do you have a specific family member with a similar condition, and if so, what was their diagnosis?

speaker: Patient
text: 18-month-old boy. The patient is brought in by his parents due to swelling in his right knee noticed after playing in the park. The parents report that there was no obvious injury or incident at the park that could have led to the swelling. Upon further questioning, the mother recalls that an uncle on her side of the family had similar problems, suggesting a possible genetic component.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Familial Juvenile Idiopathic Arthritis (Oligoarticular onset) with possible genetic predisposition.

Given the age, unilateral swelling, and strong family history, we should confirm the diagnosis. REQUEST TEST: ESR, CRP, and ANA. REQUEST IMAGES: Right knee X-ray.
